test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following powers is exercised by the Union Council of Ministers in India?

options.text: Framing policies and advising the President

solution:
The correct answer is __**Framing policies and advising the President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Union Council of Ministers is responsible for **framing policies** and providing advice to the President of India, as stipulated under Article 74 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It comprises the Prime Minister and other ministers who collectively **exercise executive powers** of the Union Government.
 
• The Council of Ministers plays a key role in **decision-making processes** related to governance, administration, and legislation.
 
• All decisions taken by the Union Council of Ministers are communicated to the President, who acts on their advice unless constitutional provisions dictate otherwise.
 
• The Council also ensures **smooth functioning of ministries** and oversees implementation of laws and policies at the national level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 74 of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• States that there shall be a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advise the President.
 
• The President is bound to act in accordance with the advice given by the Council of Ministers, except in certain situations outlined by the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Union Executive:**
 
 
• Consists of the President, Vice President, Prime Minister, and the Council of Ministers.
 
• The Council of Ministers is divided into Cabinet Ministers, Ministers of State, and Deputy Ministers.
 
• The Cabinet is the highest decision-making body within the Council.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister’s Role:**
 
 
• The Prime Minister is the head of the Union Council of Ministers and acts as a bridge between the President and the Council.
 
• He/she allocates portfolios to ministers and ensures policy decisions are implemented effectively.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Power:**
 
 
• While the Council of Ministers does not directly legislate, it plays a vital role in drafting bills and policies presented to Parliament.
 
• The Council provides inputs and advice to the President on legislative matters.
 
 
 
• **Executive Powers:**
 
 
• The Council exercises executive powers to ensure the governance of the nation is carried out effectively.
 
• These powers include policy formulation, administration of ministries, and directing national programs.
